context: M4 o5. W 29th St. A Carriers' truck idles outside Seoul Star Imports. The driver waits.

lines.speaker: char.hector_villalba
lines.text: Unit four. Collect at twenty-nine and Broadway. Don't take no for an answer.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: You want twenty dollars for protection. From what? Please, show me.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: I pay for delivery. I pay rent. I pay tax. What is this, the weather?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: He's asking a fair question, pal. What's the twenty for?

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Thank you. Now two of us are confused. Better.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: You see? Nobody sees. Fine. I pay. Give me a receipt.

lines.speaker: char.dwayne_little
lines.text: Every truck on Thirty-Seventh got a little envelope on the dash. I see 'em.
